Bettina, the official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **3 November 2025**.

- Moss's Coastal digest of 2 Nov 2025 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03".
- Your own cutover recap from 8 Dec 2025 also gives November 3 as the official handoff.

Your recap adds that you kept running PHL day to day until 21 Nov to finish the terminal cutover. Kwame took over fully on 22 Nov. If the coverage tracker needs the day-to-day ownership date, use Nov 22. For the official change, use Nov 3.
